name: Microsoft Kemps Creek Building 2 (SYD07)

address.note: Assessment Report: site is Lot 2 (southernmost lot) of The Yards estate (SSD-9522), legally described at application as Lots X and Y DP 421633 and Lot 22 DP 258414; now Lot 2 DP 1293204 in the NSW cadastre (source 9). Operator/listing sites give 769 Mamre Road

lat.note: centroid of Lot 2 DP 1293204 (NSW cadastre), the lot containing the 769 Mamre Rd address point on the west side of Mamre Rd; matches Assessment Report (The Yards fronts Mamre Rd on its east and adjoins South Creek to the west; site = southernmost Lot 2). The 706-752 Mamre Rd address point (-33.83458,150.78671) falls in Lot 10 DP 1280592 on the east side and was rejected. Campus-level, not building-specific

builder.note: construction General Contractor for the campus

developer.note: SSD applicant was Arup Pty Ltd on behalf of the end user (Microsoft asset numbers SYD05, SYD06, SYD07)

mw_it.note: per-building IT MW not stated. Assessment Report (source 2) gives 'two data storage buildings with an operational capacity of 190 Megawatts (MW)' for the whole campus (total, not IT, and not split per building); 60 x 3MW data-hall generators. Press figure ~96MW initial (source 7) unverified

mw_grid.note: campus total 190MW 'operational capacity' (source 2) - not split per building

cost_aud_m.note: CIV $1,298,942,449 for the whole SSD-10101987 campus (both buildings), not split per building; replaces press '$1.3bn' (source 7)

authority.note: determined 13 July 2023 by Chris Ritchie, Acting Executive Director, Energy, Resources and Industry Assessments, as delegate of the Minister

lodged.note: inferred from EIS attachment upload date 2021-09-14; Assessment Report (source 2) gives EIS exhibition 19 Nov - 16 Dec 2021; exact lodgement date not stated

jobs_construction.note: Assessment Report Table 2: '300 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; elsewhere 'up to 300 construction jobs' - not defined as peak or FTE-years; campus total (both buildings). Press ~300 (source 6) agrees

jobs_operational.note: Assessment Report: '79 operational jobs'; campus total (both buildings). Replaces press 'over 50' (source 6)

construction_start.note: Microsoft Local Mar 2024 update: 'preparations commenced for Building Two'. Assessment Report Stage 2 = 'shell and core works of SYD07 building'

construction_end.note: expected (Microsoft Local Mar 2024 and May 2026 updates: Building Two 'expected to be completed in 2026', 'steadily advancing')
